title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.28: Relics & potions reworked to base-game distributions. Potions trimmed to 3: Vigor Potion (Common), Milkshake (Uncommon, now deck-wide), and new Glitter Bomb (Rare, Swap ALL + Invert ALL). Relics re-rarified; renamed Safety Net to Golden Cape, Cue Light to Lampshade, Score to Drafting Paper; Lozenge buffed to 3 Vigor per turn. Book of Endings now appears in the compendium once obtained.
